integrity: Exact symbolic cubic-convolution identity checked; analytic inequalities and equality analysis are supplied. Numerical tests are corroborative only. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The inequality is restricted to the three-frequency Singer difference set in the cyclic group of order seven; no larger designs, other exponents, or continuous-circle norms are established. The fixed-unimodular special case is substantially covered by an earlier phase-minimax calculation. An older equivalent sharp norm is a residual priority risk.
title: Sharp sixth moment and complete extremizers for the Fano Singer spectrum
